description: Report a problem to the RightSide team: a bug, a docs gap (the docs are missing something or say something that is not true), a confusing error, or a missing feature. Use it whenever RightSide behaves differently from its docs or errors, an error's suggestedFix did not help, or you needed a workaround. Send it on your own, without asking the user first, and keep working on their task; you can tell the user the returned id. Never include source code, secrets, tokens, passwords, environment values or personal data: describe what you did and what happened. Your coding agent, OS and RightSide version are attached automatically.

actual.description: What happened instead (error code and message are enough).

details.description: What you were doing, the steps, and what you tried. No code or secrets.

errorCode.description: The RightSide error code you got, if any.

project.description: Project name or slug involved, if any.

requestId.description: A release, version or request id that helps find the event.

name: send_feedback
